map.输入耐洗、耐摩（干摩）、耐光色牢度等级，综合评估色牢度（1～5 级，5 级最好）: Enter washing, rubbing (dry rub) and light fastness grades to assess colour fastness comprehensively (grade 1～5, grade 5 is best)
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：wash×0.3+rub×0.3+light×0.4: Core formula (by input variables): wash×0.3+rub×0.3+light×0.4; min(wash,rub,light)
map.📖 查看「色牢度组合评估 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Colour Fastness Combination Assessment Usage Guide"
map.💡 综合分 = 耐洗×0.3 + 耐摩×0.3 + 耐光×0.4；同时以最低项作: 💡 Composite score = wash×0.3 + rub×0.3 + light×0.4; at the same time the lowest item is used as the weak-link judgement
map.色牢度等级为 1～5 级，允许半级（如 3.5）: Colour fastness grades run 1～5, and half grades (such as 3.5) are allowed
map.耐光色牢度 8 级制可按 ×5/8 折算为 5 级制: The 8-level light fastness scale can be converted to the 5-level scale by ×5/8
map.📚 深度解析：色牢度组合评估: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Colour Fastness Combination Assessment
map.染色成品质量检验：三项分级后取最低项作为综合合格依据，防止单强项掩盖弱项。: Quality inspection of dyed finished goods: after grading the three items, take the lowest as the basis for overall pass, preventing a single strong item masking a weak one.
map.染料与工艺选型对比：不同染料/固色工艺下三项牢度组合比较，择优。: Comparison of dye and process selection: compare the combination of three fastness items under different dyes and fixation processes to pick the best.
map.客户标准符合性判定：按买家明示等级（如耐洗 4 级、耐摩 3-4 级）逐项核对。: Customer standard conformity judgement: check item by item against the buyer's stated grades (such as wash grade 4, rub grade 3-4).
map.活性染色布三项牢度评估示例: Example three-item fastness assessment for reactive dyed fabric
map.耐洗 4 级、耐干摩 4-5 级、耐湿摩 3 级、耐光 5 级，加权综合约 4: Wash grade 4, dry rub grade 4-5, wet rub grade 3, light grade 5 give a weighted composite of about grade 4, but the weak link wet rub grade 3 is below the customer requirement of grade 3-4, so it is judged fail and fixation or the process must be adjusted.
map.综合评分和短板项哪个为准？: Which governs — the composite score or the weak link?
map.色牢度以最低短板项为准更安全，避免某项过差被平均掩盖；本工具同时给加权综合与短板: For colour fastness it is safer to take the lowest weak-link item as the basis, so that one very poor item is not masked by averaging; this tool gives both the weighted composite and the weak link, and pass/fail takes the weak link.
map.半级（如 3.5）怎么输入？: How do I enter half grades (such as 3.5)?
map.评定时允许半级记录，工具支持半级输入并参与分级，符合 GB/T 系列评级惯例。: Half grades are allowed when rating, and the tool supports half-grade input and includes it in the grading, consistent with GB/T series rating practice.
map.三项权重怎么定？: How are the three weights set?
map.服装常侧重耐洗与耐摩，户外侧重耐光；权重可按用途设置，默认建议短板优先、加权参考: Garment applications focus on wash and rub, outdoor applications on light; weights can be set by use, and the default recommendation is to prioritise the weak link with the composite as reference.
map.色牢度是衡量染色织物质量的重要指标。本工具对耐洗、耐摩擦、耐光三项色牢度进行加权: Colour fastness is an important indicator of dyed fabric quality. This tool performs a weighted composite assessment of wash, rubbing and light fastness, and gives a final pass judgement together with the lowest weak-link item, helping judge quickly whether a product meets quality requirements.

map.最低短板项识别与评级: Identifies and rates the lowest weak-link item
